locator: Table 2, TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing column (also Table 1 Plik posterior column); PDF p.16
conditioning: Spatially flat six-parameter base ΛCDM; Planck TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing with baseline Plik high-ell likelihood, fixed 0.06 eV neutrino; no BAO. Marginalized 1D posterior summaries, not independent measurements or a joint best-fit parameter vector.
covariance_reason: Table summaries provide marginal limits, not joint parameter covariance. Do not build diagonal measurement constraints from them.

model.primordial: Purely adiabatic scalar power-law curvature spectrum; pivot k=0.05 Mpc^-1. No primordial tensor/running/isocurvature extension in base model.
model.thermal: Standard photon/neutrino thermal history and Neff=3.046; massive neutrino must transition between relativistic and nonrelativistic energy density.
model.helium: BBN-consistent YP from PArthENoPE 1.1 grid, neutron lifetime 880.2 s, per Sec.2.1; no freely chosen helium parameter.
model.reionization: Simple tanh hydrogen and first-helium reionization; tau is sampled. Not determined by the background integral.
model.recombination: Requires ionization/recombination and drag-epoch closure used by the Planck Boltzmann calculation; the current engine does not predict these.

fixed_assumptions.role: fixed assumption; cited observational temperature error is not propagated here

fixed_assumptions.name: sum_m_nu
fixed_assumptions.role: fixed one massive plus two massless approximation

bookkeeping: omega_b=Omega_b*h^2 and omega_c=Omega_c*h^2, h=H0/100 in km s^-1 Mpc^-1.
Reported Omega_m includes massive neutrino energy today (Table1 caption). It is not (omega_b+omega_c)/h^2.
100theta_MC is a sampling approximation; 100theta_star is the numerical derived acoustic angle. Neither is a BAO observable.
Marginal means need not form an exact internally closed posterior sample; use them only as declared comparison anchors.

supported_variant.identity: Flat GR pressureless matter plus permanently massless radiation plus Lambda; exact chosen controls for the limited background/conditional-BAO experiment, not a Planck posterior draw or fixed-temperature mapping.
anchors: Chosen fractional controls, not a transcription of Planck Table2.
H0=67.4 km s^-1 Mpc^-1; Omega_m=0.315; Omega_r=0.000092; Omega_b=0.049; Omega_gamma=0.0000545; supplied z_drag=1059.
supported_variant.matter_rule: Declared Omega_m=0.315 includes baryons as a subset; the matter sector is pressureless. No separate massive-neutrino contribution or Planck omega_b/omega_c mapping.
supported_variant.radiation_rule: Declared Omega_r=0.000092 includes Omega_gamma=0.0000545 as a subset; all radiation stays massless. No T_CMB/Neff conversion is claimed.
supported_variant.flatness_rule: Omega_Lambda=1-Omega_m-Omega_r; baryons are a subset of matter, photons a subset of radiation.
lost_scope: Primordial perturbations, CMB spectra, growth and lensing
supported_variant.numerical_values_reason: Reviewer-derived synthetic controls supplied by the coordinated Reproducible experiment; not source posterior values. Consumer pins input bytes and numerical policy separately.
